# `ForgottenDouble`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Exception\ForgottenDouble`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy/blob/master/src/Exception/ForgottenDouble.php#L16) — **Version:** v0.5.0

**Extends:** `LogicException`

**Implements:** `Throwable`, `Stringable`, [`Exception\UnderstudyError`](/api/classes/Exception/UnderstudyError)

A double outlived the context that created it — almost always a double kept
in a static property or a shared fixture across `Understudy::reset()`.

Answering with `null` instead would violate the declared return type of any
non-nullable method and surface far from the actual mistake.
